messages:
tara_cs: Quick dump from today's onboarding trio — grouping asks so product + eng can triage. Short bullets, then a suggested split.

- Meridian Health (Enterprise): asks for per-route breakdown in invoices and a way to mark routes as 'test' so finance exports ignore them; quote: "We need clean month-end ledgers, test noise kills our reconciliation."
- ClearEdge (Pilot): reports search returning old documents after they push new embeddings; they suggested a callback/webhook when their upsert job finalizes.
- SparkPlay (Self-serve): confused by Dedicated trial 'accept charge' wording; they thought it was optional and dropped out.

Notes + raw: drive/hand-offs/mar-2025-capture.csv (shared). Can someone propose triage lanes? I sketched one below.

ben_pm: Thanks Tara. For ClearEdge do we have an example timeline (client upsert -> search) or sample payload? If we can repro it's infra work; if not it's onboarding doc. Also tagging Meridian as renewal-watch until billing CSV is solved.

tara_cs: ClearEdge pasted a timeline in the notes: upsert at 11:02:11, subsequent search at 11:02:25 yields old results; full reindex at 11:40 fixed it. They also pasted this minimal upsert: 

```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "route": "prod-us",
  "documents": ["doc text here"],
  "op": "upsert"
}
```

They said they poll and surface stale UI to customers; would happily accept a webhook if we can deliver one.

kai_eng: short thought: webhook generator + subscription per-customer is doable but we need to handle retries, dead-lettering and consent. Repro-wise might be indexer eventual consistency or cache TTL. I'll try to reproduce with their payload + timing in a sandbox. If reproducible I'll open an infra bug with logs. ETA tomorrow AM.

laura_fin: Meridians request for a "test route" flag is reasonable. For finance exports we can add an "exclude_from_export" column; doesn't change billing, just filter on CSV. Low-risk change on the export side. Please include sample CSV expected by Meridian.

ben_pm: Proposed triage lanes (first pass):
- Quick UX (1 sprint): add "exclude_from_export/test route" flag in billing UI, small copy tweak for Dedicated trial language.
- Investigate (sprint): webhook delivery + index-consistency repro + metrics (upsert->search latency).
- Roadmap (Q2): per-route billing drilldown / downloadable ledger and subscription manager for event webhooks.

tara_cs: I like that split. Meridian said having the CSV filter would likely remove a blocker for their renewal renewal conversation next week. Marking them renewal-watch -> high priority for quick UX.

notabot: Tip: use `/create_issue quick "exclude-export-flag"` to start a ticket template with customer quotes attached.

ben_pm: Kai, once you have repro, add logs & a minimal test case. If no repro, ask ClearEdge for exact timestamps and request a debug session.

kai_eng: Will do. If I can repro I'll tag infra and set P0; if not, we'll put ask back on customer for debug.

laura_fin: For CSV columns we need: date, route_id, route_name, usage_tokens, unit_price, amount_charged, billing_tag. Meridian provided an example CSV in the drive.

tara_cs: I created the quick UX issue and attached Meridian quote + CSV sample. Will post GH link here once CI creates it.

notabot: /create_issue quick "exclude-export-flag" created by tara_cs at 2025-03-10T15:12:00Z. Link: https://gh/repo/issues/12021

ben_pm: Great. Also, can we draft a two-line enablement note for CSMs to use with customers asking about Dedicated trial charges? Keeps messaging consistent during handoffs.

tara_cs: Draft for CSMs: "The Dedicated trial preview shows estimated monthly spend based on your expected throughput. Enabling Dedicated commits capacity; if you only want to test please use the sandbox option. Contact billing to convert trial terms." Will refine in Confluence.

kai_eng: Repro attempt scheduled for tomorrow 09:00. Will report back here.

ben_pm: Awesome. If Meridian escalates or ClearEdge shows data loss, ping me and I'll re-prioritize. Otherwise we run UX quick-win + investigate. Keeping thread open for updates. :mag_right:
